evaluator: Independent evaluator r2; executed by Blender Python after reopening the revised saved asset in Blender 4.5.15 LTS and visually comparing its revised roof zones to the saved orthophoto/OSM overlay.

criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: OSM way 910910470 is directly tagged The Moosehead Lounge, 434 North Grant Street; the captured West Lafayette BPW map labels Moosehead at the site. The named, addressed OSM ring is compared against an imagery overlay and the mesh structural outline (maximum source-to-mesh vertex residual 0.0000 m). Purdue's name query found no Moosehead; FID 855 is an Old Purdue Exponent candidate and is explicitly excluded.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The object retains campus-world coordinates and identity object transform. OSM/project local-conversion footprint bbox is [[294.6150767505242, 322.02586401651496], [145.68447999984983, 158.78719999990608]]; reopened asset world bbox is [[294.5706481933594, 322.02587890625], [145.68447875976562, 158.78720092773438]]; maximum bbox difference is 0.044 m. Orthophoto overlay supports site alignment. Approximate geographic conversion and community-mapped source are documented.
findings: The local projection is approximate rather than surveyed, and no independent parcel survey or Purdue-named GIS feature was found.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: OSM building:levels=2 supports a two-level interpretation. Reopened mesh reaches 7.60 m, with 5.25 m eaves; both heights are labeled estimates. The saved 2022–2025 Indiana orthophoto/OSM overlay shows several roof planes and a break at the stepped east/south wing; the revised asset splits the envelope into two roof zones, has 26 roof faces and 5 wall-material faces above eave level, including two terminal gable closures.
findings: No source establishes measured eave or ridge height.
Roof seam and ridge positions, and the shared 7.60 m ridge heights, remain estimated interpretations of a partly obscured overhead image.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The OSM snapshot includes 3 main entrance nodes on level 0; the revised asset models plain doors at those mapped positions (nearest door-face vertex distances [0.4638879613768754, 0.4638996341743655, 0.46387817072608034]). Renders show a plain two-level wall shell without the earlier unsupported repeated windows, bands, and trim.
findings: No direct facade photographs or elevations were located; facade materials, windows, entry construction, and distinctive wall details remain unverified. Omission of unsupported detail is appropriate, but leaves facade fidelity largely unresolved.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Independently reopened in Blender 4.5.15 LTS; exact scene/collection/object identities persist; asset collection has one mesh object, 101 vertices, 71 faces, no modifiers, and no file-backed image dependencies. Scene has 6 objects including a separate render-only collection. Source snapshots, r2 iteration/reconciliation, validation, and four refreshed renders are present.

materials: Muted warm masonry — generic material, facade unverified
evidence.geometry_iteration: r2: removed unsupported repeated windows, sill bands, and trim; retained only three OSM-mapped level-0 entry positions as schematic plain doors; split broad single roof into west/north and east/south gabled zones; added west/east gable-end wall faces; preserved exact OSM 910910470 structural ring.
evidence.revised_roof_status: Two-zone gabled roof silhouette (west/north body and east/south wing) follows visible roof-plane breaks in 2022-2025 Indiana orthophoto and OSM footprint projections. Gable-end wall faces close west and east terminal profiles. Exact roof seam positions, ridge directions, and all heights remain interpreted estimates, not survey measurements.
evidence.saved_roof_observation: The current-imagery preview and OSM overlay show a stepped east/south roof zone and multiple visible roof planes; exact vertical pitches/heights cannot be read from this overhead source.
evidence.purdue_fid_855_conflict: README assignment crosswalk identifies FID 855 as Old Purdue Exponent Building; it is not a Moosehead match.

findings: The local projection is approximate rather than surveyed, and no independent parcel survey or Purdue-named GIS feature was found.
No source establishes measured eave or ridge height.
Roof seam and ridge positions, and the shared 7.60 m ridge heights, remain estimated interpretations of a partly obscured overhead image.

No direct facade photographs or elevations were located; facade materials, windows, entry construction, and distinctive wall details remain unverified. Omission of unsupported detail is appropriate, but leaves facade fidelity largely unresolved.
uncertainties: OSM tags building:levels=2, but no scaled elevation or measured height source was found.
Eave 5.25 m and ridge 7.60 m are explicit estimates; the two-zone gable form and seam locations are interpreted from an obscured orthophoto, not measured.
Facade materials, door construction, and any window arrangement are unverified; available evidence has no street-level facade photograph or elevation.
The 2018 Indiana footprint is a conflicting merged/adjacent-roof candidate and is disclosed, not used as the shell.
Purdue GIS FID 855 is correctly excluded: the assignment queue and README map it to the Old Purdue Exponent Building.
